subject: Web Development
title: Performance as a Team Sport
description: A fast breakdown of Performance as a Team Sport for builders.

hook.text: Performance work fails when it's one person's responsibility. It takes the whole team.

buildup.text: Designers choose image-heavy layouts. Product managers add third-party scripts. Code grows.

discovery.text: When everyone owns performance — design, product, engineering — regressions get caught early.

twist.text: Most performance regressions come from business decisions, not engineering mistakes.

climax.text: Building a performance culture means making speed a shared value, not just a tech metric.

punchline.text: Speed is a team value, not one person's job.

quiz.question: Where do most performance regressions originate?
